ana (People Ops): Quick operational update for managers — two small changes for this cycle to support timezone teams + an appeals window. Please skim. :globe_with_meridians:

ana (People Ops): Key dates (recap): `Peer feedback due: 2026-03-31`, `Manager reviews due: 2026-04-10 23:59 PDT`, `Calibration week: 2026-04-13 to 2026-04-17`, `Ratings locked: 2026-04-24`. Appeals/clarifications window: `2026-04-24` -> `2026-04-29` (5 business days).

mike (People Ops): Change 1 — timezone-friendly calibration slots: we added 2 early-morning APAC-friendly slots (06:00 PDT / 19:00 JST) and 2 late-evening NA slots. You should see alternate invites titled "calibration (APAC-friendly)". Opt out if you can't attend.

mike (People Ops): Change 2 — small-team fast-track: teams of <=4 people can request a 15-minute paired calibration (manager + director) instead of the standard group slot. Use the opt-in checkbox in the invite. We recommend only for highly cross-functional pods.

sophie (Eng Manager): For the appeals window, what's the scope? Can managers request rating changes, or is it clarification only?

ana (People Ops): Good Q. Appeals/clarifications flow: first 2 business days (2026-04-24 to 2026-04-26) are for clarification requests only — add context via the "clarify" form: https://intranet.redwood/hr/clarify. Days 3-5 (up to 04-29) accept formal appeals that require People Ops + Director review. Appeals must include >1 artifact (PRs, metrics, customer notes) and a short rationale.

bryan (Director, Eng): If a manager misses the manager-review deadline due to PTO, do we still allow late submissions during calibration week?

mike (People Ops): We allow a manager-level extension up to 48h for documented PTO/medical. For misses falling into calibration week, submit the extension form and notify your calibration lead immediately — we may move you to a later slot but cannot delay final locks beyond 04-24 without Exec signoff.

tom (IC): Small ask from ICs: can peer feedback be anonymous? Some folks prefer it.

ana (People Ops): Peer feedback is anonymized by default in the system for IC -> manager flows. Managers see aggregated themes and anonymized quotes. If you see a problem with visibility, DM us.

mike (People Ops): Mini-template for calibration notes (paste into the field):
```
Context: [what changed this cycle]
Impact: [metrics, customer feedback, shipped work]
Examples: [1-2 bullets with links]
Recommendation: [Meet / Exceed / Below + 1-sentence rationale]
```

ana (People Ops): Operational reminders: attach links to PRs/tickets in the review form (click "add evidence"), RSVP to your calibration invite (we'll auto-schedule), and if you need accessibility accommodations (longer slot, captioning), reply here or email people-ops@redwood.com.

hr-bot: Reminder queued: "Manager reviews due in 7 days" will DM managers at 2026-04-03 09:00 PDT.

ana (People Ops): Thanks all — drop any odd form behavior or missing directs into this thread and we'll triage. :white_check_mark:
